title: KW Escape

services.name: Escape Room Games
services.desc: You and your team took a flight with McCarthy Airlines to Belize. Suddenly, the plane experiences turbulence and "mayday" calls are announced. You survive the crash, but now you must rebuild the GPS device before the 60-minute back up power runs out. Do you have what it takes to successfully call for rescue? Children under 14 need participating adult supervisors; children ages 8-10 can be accommodated in a family setting only - no birthday parties under age 11 Two puzzles of this game take place in an area inaccessible by wheelchair, the remainder of the spaces are accessible. You and your team are members of the Box 690 Fire Crew. You've just been called in because the KW Mall is on fire!

blurb: Are you looking for ways on how to test your logic and problem-solving skills? Check out KW Escape in Waterloo, ON! Our fun and interactive games are perfect for groups and families. If you would like to learn more about our offerings, feel free to contact our friendly staff
